FeatureProjects.Title: Projects
FeatureProjects.Label: Highlighted Project

FeatureProjects.Projects.Title: Restaurant & Cafe SaaS Platform
FeatureProjects.Projects.Description: A web application developed for a Qatari company, designed as a SaaS platform for restaurant management, available on a monthly or annual subscription basis. The system covers order management with integration to the Rafeeq Platform for receiving external orders, as well as integration with the My Fatoorah payment gateway to provide online payment services for customers. It also includes features for coupons, loyalty points, and offers provided by each restaurant, along with a dedicated section for accounting and reporting.

FeatureProjects.Projects.Title: Self-order System
FeatureProjects.Projects.Description: A self-service ordering system that enables customers to easily place their food orders, whether dining in or for takeaway. The system allows order tracking by scanning the table's QR code, with the option to reorder or complete payment electronically.

FeatureProjects.Projects.Title: Survey Management System
FeatureProjects.Projects.Description: A survey management system developed for a Saudi company, enabling dynamic management of surveys through a control panel. The system offers a range of features, including easy survey creation, the ability to reuse questions from previous surveys, full survey duplication with the option for further editing, and easy publishing across different portals with various themes. It also allows users to review survey results and display reports through graphical charts.

FeatureProjects.Projects.Title: Permits Portal Management System
FeatureProjects.Projects.Description: An integrated project delivered for a Saudi authority to manage entry permits for personnel and vehicles. The system allows company representatives to register, submit new requests, and track their status through an online portal, linking each permit to specific projects. Requests follow a structured workflow with multi-level approvals, role-based dashboards, and automated progression between steps. Authorized users can review, approve, reject, or print permits, while the platform maintains detailed audit trails, request histories, and reporting on active and expired permits. This ensures compliance, transparency, and efficient handling of sensitive access procedures.

FeatureProjects.Projects.Title: Recruitment Requests Management System
FeatureProjects.Projects.Description: An integrated project delivered for a Saudi authority to manage job applications. Provides an electronic portal for posting vacancies, submitting applications, conducting online tests, tracking results, multi-level approvals, interviews, and sending SMS notifications.

FeatureProjects.Projects.Title: HR Management System
FeatureProjects.Projects.Description: System settings & configuration, Organizational structure management, Institution regulations & policies, Attendance & departure tracking, External tasks/assignments management, Leave management, Salaries & financial transactions (loans, advances, bonuses, deductions, payment vouchers), Wage increments & employee allowances etc ..

FeatureProjects.Projects.Title: Pharmacy Management System
FeatureProjects.Projects.Description: I independently developed a freelance project for managing pharmacies and warehouses, covering medicine stock, prescriptions, supplier records, billing, and inventory tracking through efficient processes.

FeatureProjects.Projects.Title: ATTA Management System
FeatureProjects.Projects.Description: I independently developed a freelance project for managing a psychological consultation center, covering patient bookings, session scheduling, case follow-up, specialized services, and financial and administrative reporting.
